title: How to Deploy a Cursor App to Production
summary: How to deploy a Cursor app to production: the DIY stack costs $295/mo across 12 accounts. Blink Cloud ships database, auth, and hosting in 2 commands, 2 minutes.
body_markdown: With Blink Cloud, 2 minutes from prompt to live URL with SSL. The DIY path — Vercel + Supabase + Clerk + AWS S3 — takes 3–6 hours the first time you do it, including the four failure modes (env vars, auth callbacks, schema drift, cold starts) that typically require a second debugging session. Read[what to do after Cursor writes your code](https://blink.new/blog/deploy-cursor-app-production) for the full deployment checklist.
